## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juan* Sòng-period commentary by **Liǎorán** 了然 (1077–1141) on Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* ([KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157)). Companion to Liǎorán's other major Sòng *shānjiā* commentary, the *Dàshèng zhǐguān fǎmén zōngyuán jì* ([KR6d0153](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0153)) on Huìsī's *Dàshèng zhǐguān fǎmén*.

**Abstract**

Liǎorán's *Shūyào* belongs to the late-Northern-Sòng / early-Southern-Sòng productive period of the *shānjiā* commentarial tradition. Together with the broader *Shí bùèr mén* commentarial corpus ([KR6d0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0158)–[KR6d0165](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0165)), it documents the mature Sòng Tiāntái scholastic engagement with Zhànrán's foundational doctrinal apparatus.

The composition is bracketed within Liǎorán's productive period c. 1095–1141.
